title: davallia undulata
intro: Davallia undulata, commonly known as the leather fern, is a species of fern belonging to the Davallia genus. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used in various cultures for its health benefits. The leather fern has been found to possess therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its ability to aid in wound healing, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Davallia undulata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are being researched for their potential in treating various diseases.
